# Austrade

> Austrade is the Australian Government agency supporting Australian businesses in exports, international investment, and the visitor economy through market access, grants, and strategic partnerships.

Austrade (Australian Trade and Investment Commission) operates as the primary trade and investment promotion body for Australia, maintaining a global network of offices to connect Australian exporters, investors, and education providers with international opportunities. The organization manages key programs including the Export Market Development Grants (EMDG) and provides comprehensive support across multiple sectors including education, tourism, and advanced manufacturing.

## Key Topics

- Export Market Development Grants (EMDG)
- Trade and investment promotion
- Australian exporters
- International investors and buyers
- Education export
- Tourism and visitor economy
- THRIVE 2030 strategy
- Market expansion support
- First Nations businesses
- Southeast Asia opportunities
- Business grants and funding
- Austrade services and programs
- Trade analysis and insights
- Australian Export Awards
- Accessing New Markets Initiative

## Core Services & Support

- [How we can help you](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/how-we-can-help-you): Austrade programs & advice for exporters, investors, education & tourism
- [Australian exporters](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/how-we-can-help-you/australian-exporters): Export support services, toolkits & market opportunities via Austrade
- [Grants](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/how-we-can-help-you/grants): Austrade grants including EMDG & tourism funding for businesses
- [International investors and buyers](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/how-we-can-help-you/international-investors-and-buyers): Investment promotion & international buyer connections to Australia
- [Programs, services and policies](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/how-we-can-help-you/programs-and-services): Austrade programs & services for export, investment & trade support

## Sector-Specific Programs

- [Education providers and students](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/how-we-can-help-you/education-providers-and-students): Education export promotion, market data & Study Australia resources
- [Tourism industry](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/how-we-can-help-you/tourism-sector): Tourism & visitor economy support, data & THRIVE 2030 strategy
- [Working groups and engagement](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/how-we-can-help-you/working-groups-and-engagement): Austrade stakeholder engagement & industry consultation working groups

## News, Analysis & Intelligence

- [News and analysis](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/news-and-analysis): Austrade news hub with trade analysis & export/investment publications
- [Austrade analysis](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/news-and-analysis/analysis): Expert trade analysis & market insights on international opportunities
- [Austrade news](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/news-and-analysis/news): Austrade news articles on trade, investment & business opportunities
- [Publications and reports](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/news-and-analysis/publications-and-reports): Austrade reports, annual reports & market research publications

## About Austrade

- [About Austrade](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/about-austrade): Overview of Austrade's role in trade promotion, investment & visitor attraction

- [Our team](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/about-austrade/our-team): Austrade executive team structure and international office locations
- [Ministers](https://www.austrade.gov.au/en/about-austrade/ministers): Austrade ministerial leadership under Trade & Tourism portfolio
